question: How did the English King Charles II acquire Bombay in 1661?
options: By defeating the Marathas in a naval battle
As part of the dowry when he married the Portuguese princess Catherine of Braganza
Through a treaty of purchase from the Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb
By capturing it from the Dutch East India Company
explanation: Bombay was given to King Charles II of England as part of the dowry when he married Catherine of Braganza, the daughter of King John IV of Portugal, under the Anglo-Portuguese Marriage Treaty of 1661.

question: In 1668, King Charles II transferred the island of Bombay to the English East India Company for a nominal annual rent of:
explanation: Finding the administration of Bombay expensive and difficult, King Charles II leased the islands of Bombay to the East India Company in 1668 for an annual rent of 10 pounds in gold.
